title: Zephyr: epoch persistence
description: Epoch persistence in Zephyr. DONE - epoch_persist.c
notes: 2026-08-27 leaf audit found the existing DONE implementation is not spec-compliant. spec/02-physical-link.md section 4.4 and test/vectors/epoch_rollover.json require ordinary unsigned ordering, forbid 255-to-0 wrap, require cold boot 128..255, and require fail-closed behavior when freshness cannot be established. epoch_persist.c instead explicitly permits 255-to-0, treats missing/corrupt/read-failed state as persisted zero then chooses epoch 1, ignores settings_load_subtree errors, mutates s_boot_epoch and s_advanced before confirming the save, and returns an epoch even when persistence fails. Its uint8_t lichen_link_epoch_advance_for_boot(void) API cannot propagate read/write/corruption/exhaustion errors; l2/lichen_l2_init.c also ignores lichen_link_set_epoch return. Focused tests encode the obsolete wrap behavior and have no torn/corrupt/failure cases. A correct bounded repair requires an error-returning API plus changes to link_ctx.h and l2/lichen_l2_init.c, beyond the assigned clean target set of epoch_persist.c and persistence tests. No files modified; claim released for broader coordinated repair.
